summary: Independent experimenter read the actual populated PAIRING-011 finite-check packet and frozen author statement f93c024abd19699640e90bb5680306432c2bb71600acd77a0b66024a6658645b. One smoke and one bounded final run passed with no failures. The exact checks cover 29 signed-square/Cauchy cases, 165 integer cofactor records, 457 quadratic pairs, 5120 coprime determinant/cofactor cases and 81 complex-conjugation cases; 112 comparison degree cases, 5960 congruence pairs, 3542 pullback branch certificates, 15 determinant-H complements and 25 geometric sector pairs; and 18 ordered-padding cases, 27 group mass cases, 84 active-list cases and three nonzero J=2 per-group factorial cases. Final check-body runtime was 0.0261485 seconds on Python 3.11.17, Windows-10-10.0.26300-SP0; code hash c5d2e16afc0863661c4595ddb5f61684fd2407706418865a7f42af0dbf409898. Commands, ranges, hashes and exact witnesses are saved. Token usage and monetary cost are unknown. Geometric coverage is sparse and does not verify a localization asymptotic, automatic primitivity at asymptotic Z separation, ambient moment, good-state replacement, physical kernel reassembly, TypeII estimate or Goldbach.

claims.text: The positive Cauchy inequality, addition of negative-cofactor squares, nonzero cofactor under unit support, direct quadratic expansion, raw psi plateau and coprime determinant/cofactor equivalence pass exactly on the stated finite domains. The Gaussian endpoint product has the author's conjugations.

The finite comparison row and column degrees satisfy ceil(4MN/H)<=4, pullback branch normalization retains no extra 1/H, and tested canonical determinant-H complements, sector maps and rational slope bounds pass exactly. Only 25 endpoint pairs occur in the preregistered geometric boxes, and their maximum cell distance is zero.

The exact harmonic weight identity (16), ordered-draw dyadic reassembly of an arbitrary signed Gaussian endpoint-pair coefficient, invariant-list averaging, distinguished-entry accounting, per-group factorial conversion and explicit finite collision/exclusion union bound pass. Good padding mass is retained even when it is zero or far below one; the full physical operator identity (17) is not certified by these scalar weight checks.

The omitted hypotheses and normalizations fail on explicit witnesses: shared a=b=3 permits determinant equality with cofactor 1/3; omitted unit support permits h=0; wrong endpoint conjugation changes i to -i; unordered padding without its factorial halves 1470/5041; and the entrywise mn<H mask at H=22 increases a norm witness from squared norm 4 to 5.

The analytic overlap/AP-divisor bounds, primitive support at large Z, moment transport, Gram estimate, positive bad-state replacement, physical-kernel identification and asymptotic reassembly errors remain outside finite coverage. These computations do not establish (10), the major comparison bound or Goldbach.
